summary: CTU Code／CSS Code算出ロジックを再監査。CTU境界抵抗の自動算入を廃止し、摩擦係数の表示・実計算を同期。支保と直接固縛は保守的評価で単純加算せず、トップオーバーは垂直掛け前提を明示。
notes: CTU boundary resistance requires explicit tight-stow/load-transfer confirmation plus verified payload P. Step 4 friction and calculation μ are synchronized; direct securing uses 75% friction. In conservative mode, support/blocking and direct lashing are not arithmetically added even when the quick coexistence check is marked; approved addition requires the detailed approved-method mode. Top-over quick calculation is explicitly limited to the vertical-lashing 1.8×STF reference. CSS Annex 13 functions/constants remain source-mapped to Part478.
